scope: Raw-edible-ingredient mass balance: one full batch is divided into two servings. All edible ingredients, melted butter and rendered cooking fat are explicitly served in the finished dish. No side dishes. This is a composition-based estimate, not a laboratory measurement of the cooked food; animal fat content and package-label rounding vary.

ingredients.matchEvidence: Exact Snellman 20% label for protein/fat/available CHO; AFCD F000678 raw beef mince paired sugar-alcohol-free carbohydrate zero and fibre zero are used as documented composition correspondence.
